AULA SC580 Wireless Gaming Mouse (12000 DPI Optical Sensor / 6 Programmable Buttons / Lightweight Ergonomic Form Factor / Dynamic RGB Illumination)

Achieve precision and lightning-fast responsiveness with the AULA SC580 Wireless Gaming Mouse, available now at Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered to deliver an exceptional balance of speed and tracking accuracy, this mouse features a high-performance optical gaming sensor capable of scaling up to 12000 DPI. Equipped with 6 fully programmable buttons, players can customize macros, hotkeys, and profile setups to optimize layout efficiency for intensive competitive matches. Built inside an ultra-lightweight, streamlined ergonomic chassis, the SC580 contours naturally to various grip styles to minimize hand fatigue during extended desktop sessions. Powered by an advanced low-latency high-speed wireless tracking module and backed by a long-lasting rechargeable battery cell configuration, it features customizable dynamic RGB accent light loops to integrate beautifully with any modern battle station layout matrix.
